title: Repeating the jobs where the quantisations disagreed
compared: IQ2_M against Q4_K_M with 64 batch threads, on the jobs whose class was right under one and wrong under the other.
sample: 3 audited public jobs, replayed three times per setting on an aarch64 test VM.
verdict: IQ2_M got 3 of 9 classes right and Q4_K_M 4 of 9. Inside the noise.
